name: Sentinels
summary: Across Kalimdor, the Sentinels defend night elf lands and meet the Horde in battle. Formed after the War of the Ancients, this elite force is guided by the Sisterhood of Elune and led by General Shandris Feathermoon. Its mostly female ranks guard settlements and sacred ground from Ashenvale to Feralas, and watch over the night elves’ new home on Teldrassil.

sections.title: Born from the Sundering
sections.body:
The Sentinels took shape after the War of the Ancients laid bare the failures of the old Kaldorei military. Before the Great Sundering, noble birth decided rank in the ancient Kaldorei Empire, while skill in battle counted for little. That order could not shield Azeroth from the war’s devastation.

Afterward, High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind remade night elf society. She looked to the Sisterhood of Elune, an order that had survived intact and knew tactics, combat, and healing. From its devoted ranks, Tyrande formed a standing army to guard the growing society, whatever a Sentinel’s heritage.

sections.title: Structure and Warfare
sections.body:
Tyrande Whisperwind remains the Sentinels’ spiritual supreme commander. Her lieutenant, General Shandris Feathermoon, directs their active military from Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas. Sentinel discipline is known in the bow and the deadly moonglaive, and in their specialized forces.

Elite archers fight beside huntresses riding nightsabers. Scouts mounted on hippogryphs command the skies. Centuries before the Third War, the Sentinels fought under Archdruid Fandral Staghelm in the brutal War of the Shifting Sands in Silithus, where they halted the qiraji swarm. From Astranaar to Darnassus’s spreading branches, night elf settlements rely on Sentinel garrisons for protection.

sections.title: Defending Sacred Soil
sections.body:
During the Third War, the Sentinels faced demons and early Horde incursions in desperate battles. They suffered immense losses when Cenarius fell in Ashenvale. They survived the Battle of Mount Hyjal and pursued Illidan across Lordaeron, then returned to a changed Kalimdor.

Now danger presses from several fronts. On Teldrassil, garrisons face corrupted wildlife and enraged furbolgs. Farther south in Warsong Gulch, the Silverwing Sentinels fight the Warsong Outriders. They are determined to drive the Horde from Ashenvale and protect the ancient forests from further exploitation.

aliases: who is in charge of sentinels
faq.answer: High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind guides the Sentinels politically and spiritually, and founded them from the Sisterhood of Elune. General Shandris Feathermoon commands the army day to day from Feathermoon Stronghold and directs its operations across Kalimdor.

Most Sentinels are female because night elf society traditionally divided spiritual and martial duties by gender. Women dominated Elune’s priesthood and formed the Sentinels, while men overwhelmingly joined the Cenarion Circle as druids. That division shaped the army for millennia, though society has slowly begun to shift since the Third War.

faq.q: Where is the Sentinels' main base of operations?
faq.answer: The Sentinels’ primary fortress outside Darnassus is Feathermoon Stronghold, on an island off the coast of Feralas. They also keep prominent garrisons across Ashenvale, including Astranaar and Silverwing Outpost.

faq.q: What weapons do the Sentinels specialize in?
faq.answer: Sentinels are celebrated archers who use recurve bows, and the three-bladed moonglaive is their cultural hallmark. Huntresses wield glaives from nightsaber panthers, while riders strike from armored hippogryphs.

faq.q: Why are the Sentinels fighting in Warsong Gulch?
faq.answer: The Silverwing Sentinels fight the Horde’s Warsong Outriders over Ashenvale. The orcs have cut heavily into the forest for lumber, violating woods the night elves hold sacred. The Sentinels are determined to drive out every invader.

faq.q: Did the Sentinels fight in the Third War?
faq.answer: Yes. The Sentinels formed the main front-line defense when the Burning Legion and the Scourge marched on Kalimdor. Led by Tyrande, they held the line until they joined forces with human and orc refugees. The fighting ended in victory at the Battle of Mount Hyjal.

angles.text: As a kaldorei, your hamlet relies on the Sentinels’ watch. Many young women aspire to join the army of Shandris and Tyrande.
As a member of the Horde, you face lethal woodland skirmishers who strike from Ashenvale’s shadows and fight your logging efforts.
As a hunter, you see Sentinel archers and nightsaber-riding huntresses as masters of marksmanship and animal companionship on Kalimdor.
As a priest, you share a bond between military duty and devotion to the Moon Goddess. The Sentinels were formed from the Sisterhood of Elune.
